faqs.question: I see horizontal or vertical lines in my printout. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Perform a nozzle check from the printer's control panel or the Epson printer driver, then do one of the following:
If there are gaps in the nozzle check pattern, clean the print head nozzles.
If there are no gaps in the nozzle check pattern, try the solutions below.
Horizontal Banding
Increase the print resolution.
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Select an alternate paper profile for ink coverage.
Select the correct paper type in the printer driver.
Adjust the paper feed
Vertical Banding
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Align the print head.

faqs.question: The colors on my printouts do not match the colors on my computer monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following recommended color correction methods:
Use ICC profiles during the color management process.
Ensure that you are using the correct output profile for your loaded media.
Note:
You may need to create a custom ICC profile for the best results.
Ensure that your monitor is calibrated and is displaying accurate color.
Compare the print result with the image on your computer screen in a well-lit environment. Since monitors and printers produce colors differently, printed colors and screen colors do not always look the same.
If the recommendations above do not help, contact Epson support.
The color management process is complex. We can assist you with the proper assignment of settings; however, we cannot assist you with creating a custom color profile.

faqs.question: I see the message Communication Error when I use a USB connection. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Delete all print jobs in the print queue.
Turn the printer off.
Note:
Make sure the USB cable is connected correctly.
Restart your computer. When the desktop appears, turn your printer on and follow the on-screen instructions.
Note:
If the problem continues, turn the printer off again and delete the printer in the list of printers. Then disconnect the USB cable from the printer and connect it again.

faqs.question: A connection error appears after I installed a new or updated printer driver on my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Uninstall the Epson printer driver. To uninstall the printer driver, go to the                 Downloads tab for your product, select
Uninstaller v1.3.1
, and follow the on-screen                 instructions to complete the uninstall.
Install Epson printer driver ver. 10.85. This driver version has limited print                 options, but it should resolve this issue.
Note:
An updated printer driver will be available later to resolve the                     problem.
Tip:
If your printer stops printing after                 entering sleep mode, you need to wake the printer up to print again.

faqs.question: Can I print photographic output with my product?
faqs.answer:
Although the printer is capable of delivering quality prints, the SureColor T-Series is designed for engineering, CAD, and GIS markets.
For information about Professional Imaging printers please visit the Epson Store.

faqs.question: What is the smallest drop size my product will produce?
faqs.answer: The smallest drop is 3.5 picoliters.

faqs.question: Are there different size ink cartridges available?
faqs.answer: The printer supports three sizes of Epson Ultrachrome XD ink: 110 ml, 350 ml, or 700 ml. You can mix-and-match different sizes for each color.

faqs.question: Does my product automatically switch between the Matte Black and the Photo Black ink cartridge when I change the media selection in the driver to a matte or photo ink media type?
faqs.answer: Yes. The printer will automatically switch to the correct black ink.

faqs.question: Is the Dual-Roll feature an option?
faqs.answer:
The Dual-roll feature is only available on the T5270D or T7270D models and is not separately available.
Note:
The T3270 does not have a version with a Dual-Roll feature.

faqs.question: What is the thickest media my product will feed?
faqs.answer:
The printer can handle rigid media with a thickness of up to 1.5 mm.
Note:
The Multifunction Module can handle rigid media with a thickness of up to 1.3 mm.

faqs.question: Does my product support roll and cut sheet media?
faqs.answer:
Yes, the printer supports both roll media and cut sheet media.
Note:
Full borderless print jobs are supported on select roll media widths.

faqs.question: Can I set up and install the printer myself?
faqs.answer: No. The SureColor T3270 requires two people to place the printer on the stand, while the SureColor T5270/T5250D/T7270/T7270D require four people to mount the printer on the stand.

faqs.question: Can the Internal Print Server support more than one printer?
faqs.answer: No. After the initial server's installation, a serial number is assigned to the printer. The server will print only to the printer with the correct serial number.

faqs.question: Does the SureColor Multifunction Module need to be installed during the initial setup of my product or can it be added later?
faqs.answer:
The module is an option and can be added later.
Note:
The Multifunction Module is not available for the T3270 printer.

faqs.question: Does my product come with an AutoCAD driver?
faqs.answer: The printer does not come with an AutoCAD driver.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the SureColor T-Series products?
faqs.answer:
The printers support different paper widths (as detailed in the table below), and the T5270D and T7270D models support two rolls of paper.
Model
Maximum Print Width
SureColor T3270, Single-Roll
24" inches
SureColor T5270, Single-Roll
36" inches
SureColor T5270D, Dual-Roll
36" inches
SureColor T7270, Single-Roll
44" inches
SureColor T7270D, Dual-Roll
44" inches
Note:
The Automatic Take-up Reel System (Part Number SCT72TUR) is available only for the T7270.

faqs.question: What is the main purpose of the Internal Print Server?
faqs.answer:
The print server allows you to save print jobs and re-print them from control panel.
Note:
You cannot use a print server from a different print model (such as the T3000, T5000, or T7000 models) with the T3270, T5270, T5270D, T7270, or T7270D models .

faqs.question: Does a printer stand come with my product?
faqs.answer: Yes. The printers come with a printer stand and a print basket.
